mechanism_of_action: A polyethylene glycol-conjugated analog of human fibroblast growth factor 21, a nonmitogenic hormone that regulates energy metabolism.
primary_endpoint: At week 48, improvement of ≥1 stage in the NASH Clinical Research Network fibrosis score without NASH worsening.
efficacy_outcome: Primary endpoint responses occurred in 24%–28% of pegbelfermin arms versus 31% with placebo (P = .361).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events were more frequent with pegbelfermin than placebo, though none were treatment related. One patient receiving 40 mg discontinued because of worsening ascites.
